items.title: Geoff Bull Interview, 1966-05-13
items.q: Of course you have all the old Aiden Monspras and all the old Lou Waters type musicians go, what's all this rubbish

ctx.x: That's right, yeah. Anyway, what happened then? Oh, that's right. Well, from there, you know, I got off the Ken Colgate kick, started the band I had. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

When did these brass bands start really? About three or four years ago I think was the first one at the convention. Of course you have all the old Aiden Monspras and all the old Lou Waters type musicians go, what's all this rubbish, what's this garbage, that's not jazz. Anyway, they started off having one then and they've had one every convention since then but it's always been a sort of very disorganized thing. Last year was the first time we ever got an organization.

But they don't play otherwise, they don't play for funerals or anything. No sir. Do they have friendly societies in Australia, what they call friendly societies in England? Very rarely, very rarely. It's not a very well organized country like here where everybody is organization minded, huh?
